description.name: Description
description.value: You have Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma attacks rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

description.name: Description
description.value: You can't cast spells, except for cantrips with a casting time of 1 action.

description.name: Description
description.value: If you have the Bleeding condition, you cannot regain Hit Points except by spending Hit Point Dice or completing a Long Rest. The condition ends when a creature finishes a Quick, Short, or Long Rest

description.name: Description
description.value: You're losing blood to an open wound.

description.name: Ongoing Damage
description.value: At the end of each of your turns, you lose Hit Points. The number of Hit Points lost is indicated by the condition, such as "Bleeding 2d4."

description.name: Regaining Hit Points
description.value: The condition ends if you regain any Hit Points.

description.name: Medical Treatment
description.value: You or another creature within 5 feet of you can spend an action and use a healer's kit to staunch the bleeding (no check required), ending the condition.

description.name: Description
description.value: You're on fire or covered in acid:

description.name: Ongoing Damage
description.value: At the end of each of your turns, you take damage. The damage type and amount are indicated by the condition, such as "Burning (4d6 Fire)" or "Burning (2d4 Acid)."

description.name: Ending the Condition
description.value: The condition ends if you or another creature within 5 feet of you can spend an action to extinguish the flames or scrape off the acid, or if some other effect douses the flames (such as being submerged in water).

description.name: Description
description.value: You have Disadvantage on Dexterity attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

description.name: Description
description.value: While you have Contamination, you experience the following effects.

description.name: Contamination Levels
description.value: This condition is cumulative. Each time you receive it, you gain one or more levels of Contamination. You undergo a Monstrous Transformation if your Contamination level reaches 6.

description.name: Contamination Symptoms
description.value: A Contaminated creature suffers the symptoms from its current level as well as all lower levels. Conditions gained from Contamination end when those Contamination levels end. There is no other way to remove conditions caused by symptoms of Contamination.

table.title: Contamination Symptoms
rows: Halve the Hit Points you regain when you expend Hit Dice during a Short Rest
You do not regain Hit Points when you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Mutations
description.value: Each time you gain a Contamination level, roll 1d6. If the result is equal to or lower than your current Contamination level, you gain a randomly determined mutation by rolling on the [Mutations](https://5e.tools/tables.html#mutations_monstersofdrakkenheim) table. The effects of the mutation remain while you have Contamination levels. Unless otherwise specified, a creature can't gain the same mutation more than once. If a duplicate result is rolled, the GM chooses a different one or rolls again.

description.name: Long Rests
description.value: Each time you finish a Long Rest while you have 1 or more Contamination levels, roll 1d20. On a 1, you gain a Contamination level.

description.name: Removing Contamination Levels
description.value: Only specific magic can remove Contamination levels:

entries: The __Purge Contamination__ spell
__Heal__ removes all Contamination levels and mutations in addition to its other effects.
Contamination is not a curse, poison, or disease. Spells such as __Lesser Restoration__, __Protection from Poison__, and __Remove Curse__ do not remove Contamination levels.
Being raised from the dead reduces a creature's Contamination level by 1.

description.value: When your Contamination level reaches 0, the condition ends, as well as the effects of all mutations.

Skin, hair, fingernails, and toenails lost to mutations regrow normally once Contamination is removed. However, a __Regenerate__ spell or similar magic is needed to restore any other body parts (such as teeth, limbs, or eyes) lost due to Contamination. Appendages or limbs that develop as a result of mutations wither and fall off when Contamination is removed, and other warped body parts are restored to their original form.

description.name: Dying with Contamination Levels
description.value: If you die while you have one or more Contamination levels, your corpse reanimates as a __Haze Husk__ 24 hours later. A creature with six or more class levels or hit dice rises as a __Haze Wight__ instead.

description.name: Monstrous Transformation!
description.value: If you end your turn with six or more Contamination Levels, you permanently transform into a horrific monster controlled by the Game Master.

entries: The Game Master chooses the new form, which is most often an Aberration or Monstrosity of some kind such as a __Gibbering Mouther__, __Delerium Dreg__, or __Pyknic Maunder__.
Your game statistics are entirely replaced by those of the chosen monster, including the new form's Hit Points and Hit Dice.
All Contamination levels are removed, though the GM may grant additional traits to the new form similar to any beneficial mutations gained from Contamination Levels.
The Game Master determines what remains of the original creature's personality and memories, if anything. Regardless, the creature falls under the Game Master's control.

description.name: Reversing the Transformation
description.value: A __Wish__ spell or similar magic can restore a single transformed creature to its previous form, removing all Contamination and restoring the original creature's personality and memories. This is considered a stressful use of the __Wish__ spell, and thus there is a 33 percent chance that the caster will be unable to cast __Wish__ ever again if they use the spell in this manner.
Note that the means of reversing a monstrous transformation are completely unknown at the outset of the campaign. A Monstrous Transformation is widely regarded as permanent.

description.name: Description
description.value: While you have the Corruption condition, you experience the following effects.

description.name: Heroic Corruption
description.value: You cannot have Heroic Inspiration or give it to another player character who lacks it.

description.name: Corruption Levels
description.value: This condition is cumulative. Each time you receive it, you gain 1 Corruption level. If your Corruption level is 6, you either die or transform into a creature of the GM's choosing, under their control.

description.name: Removing Corruption Levels
description.value: The __Greater Restoration__, __Heal__, or __Wish__ spell removes all of your Corruption levels and ends the condition.

description.name: Description
description.value: If you have the Dazed condition, you cannot maintain Concentration.

description.name: Description
description.value: You can move or take an action on your turn, not both. You can't take Bonus Actions.

description.name: Description
description.value: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

description.name: Description
description.value: You can't take Reactions.

description.name: Description
description.value: A character with Drakkenheim Madness gains one of the following traits:

entries: "I wish I didn't have all these useless organs inside me."
"The contamination is a blessing which will transform me into a wondrous creature."
"The monsters are civilians trying to live a peaceful life! We need to protect them!"
"I must wear a flesh-coat made from my slain enemies to gain their strength!"
"My companions died in the ruins. I'm sorry friends, you are merely ghosts haunting me, you aren't real. Stop trying to talk to other people."
"I need to eat everything I can find. It's probably going to be my last meal."
"Drakkenheim is so beautiful at night. I could spend forever wandering the streets by moonlight. We should go tonight! Let's go every night!"
"Don't you fools get it?! If you die in Drakkenheim, you die IN REAL LIFE!!!!"
"A sinister cabal of disembodied hands is plotting against me."
"I must go into the ruins and kill. Rip and tear, until it is done."

description.name: Description
description.value: You have Disadvantage on Strength attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

description.name: Description
description.value: Ennui drains motion and memory, reflecting the soul-sapping power of Dolurrh. This special condition is measured in levels, and has the same effects and rules as Exhaustion (as presented in the Rules Glossary of the Player's Handbook), with one exception—Ennui affects all creatures that aren't native to Dolurrh, including Undead and other creatures that have Immunity to Exhaustion. Ennui is separate from Exhaustion, and Exhaustion levels don't stack with Ennui. If a creature has both Ennui and Exhaustion, use whichever condition it has more levels of to determine the effects.

Undead can't recover from Ennui while in Dolurrh. Whenever a living creature with 2 or more levels of Ennui finishes a Long Rest, if it succeeds against its saving throw against Dolurrh's Inevitable Entrapment property by 5 or more, it reduces its Ennui level by 1. When a creature leaves Dolurrh, all levels of Ennui are removed.

When a creature reaches 6 levels of Ennui, its will is completely broken and it can take no purposeful action; if this happens to a living creature, its physical body dies and it becomes a husk bound to Dolurrh.

description.name: Description
description.value: You're partially encased in ice:

entries: You're Immobilized and Defenseless.
You're Helpless against attacks made with a weapon that deals Bludgeoning damage.

You or another creature take an action to break the ice away. To do so, you must succeed on a Strength (*Athletics*) check. On a successful check, the condition ends. The DC is indicated by the condition, such as Frozen (DC 15).
This condition ends on you if you take 20 Bludgeoning or Fire damage.

description.name: Description
description.value: Any attack that hits you is a Critical Hit.

entries: Your Speed becomes 0, and you can't benefit from any bonuses to your Speed.
If you're flying when you become Immobilized, you fall.

description.name: Description
description.value: Roll the die indicated by the condition, such as "Jinxed 1d4" each time you make an attack roll or saving throw. Subtract the value on the die from the result.

entries: You're Dazed and Defenseless.
You drop whatever you're holding in your hands.
You must spend an action to draw, stow, or pick up an object.

description.name: Description
description.value: You have Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.

description.name: Description
description.value: Your Speed is halved.

description.name: Description
description.value: You can't make more than one weapon attack during your turn, regardless of your class features, spells, or magic items.

description.name: Description
description.value: Add a die to your attack rolls and saving throws. The die rolled is specified by the condition, such as Valor (1d4)

description.name: Description
description.value: You deal half damage with weapon attacks and spells.
